uv: u=(lon+180)/360, v=(90-lat)/180 from TOP (flipY=false); in three.js default flipY=true use v=1-(90-lat)/180 i.e. (lat+90)/180
face_note: TestiFace in props2 testimonials-map lod0/lod1 is 5.6x2.8 => 1 px(2048) = 2.73 mm
world_pos: x=(u-0.5)*5.6, y=(0.5-v_top)*2.8 on face plane, z=+0.02 for pins

pins.sheet: pins-sheet.png (384x128, 3 cells: default, hover, selected) + pins-sheet-64.png
pins.anchor: tip at cell (0.5, 0.97) -> sprite center offset y=+0.47*size

roughness_note: oceans ~0.55, land ~0.8; if face stays Unlit, ignore normal/rough
